notes.title: Costa Verde version 1.1 released!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! A new version of Costa Verde has just dropped, mostly incorporating some ideas you folks  suggested in the discussions. Here's a list of what's changed:

[list]
[*] The game now runs on MacOS, on both Intel & Apple Silicon CPU. There might be some very minor visual glitches, though. The application isn't signed, so you might need to allow the system to execute it. I promise it is not a virus :)
[*] A new map was added - Terra Nova - which basically a flat hexagon for you to experiment with. To make things a bit more interesting, this map still has a few forests, and a river typically going through the map center (it is random, though, and can go in pretty weird paths).
[*] Windowed mode is now supported, and can be selected from the video settings menu.
[*] Some players suggested removing the water ripples for some extra performance, which is now also supported in the video settings.
[*] I improved image format support in the game's engine, which allowed to compress the textures and get a 3x reduction in the total game installation size.
[/list]

Hope you'll enjoy this little update. Have a good day :)
